SELECT ?vav ?zone ?sensor WHERE {
  ?ahu a brick:AHU .
  ?ahu brick:feeds ?vav .
  ?vav a brick:VAV .
  ?vav brick:hasPart ?zone .
  ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone .
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?sensor .
  ?sensor a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor .
  FILTER (STR(?ahu) = "http://buildgraph.org/BG_large_office_2004_0000#AHU03")
}

SELECT ?zone ?sensor WHERE {
  ?vav a brick:VAV .
  ?vav brick:feeds ?zone .
  ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone .
  ?vav brick:hasPoint ?sensor .
  ?sensor a brick:Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor .
  FILTER (STRSTARTS(STR(?zone), "http://buildgraph.org/BG_large_office_2004_0000#Zone_F4"))
}
